full_track.tags: K-Pop Indie Folk. Acoustic guitar plays a fingerstyle pattern with a steady thumb-picked bass line and arpeggiated upper notes. A soft, muffled kick drum enters on the downbeats. Male vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate baritone register with light compression and subtle room reverb. The bass guitar plays melodic, legato lines that bridge chord transitions. Tempo is 78 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the acoustic guitar and the vocal melody.
